summary: iter53 features tested end-to-end on the preview URL. Interview scheduling UI (schedule, chip, reschedule prefill, past-date 422 toast, still correct after reload), the interview email/reminder pipeline (interview_scheduled log, reminder sent once, 2nd run sent=0, HR gets 403), the announcement reminder badge and panel summary line (79 nudges, employee1 who had read it was skipped, 2nd run sent=0, HR/employee get 403), the Leavers report (month filter, row data, empty state, CSV download leavers-2025-03.csv with the leaver's name) and the leavers role gate (payroll section hidden, 403 for payroll and employee on report and report.csv) all PASS. Smoke check as admin1 on /recruitment, /announcements and /analytics: no page errors and no failed requests.

minor.issue: Deletes announcement_reads but not announcement_reminders. Reminder records are left orphaned.

A tenant admin can trigger the sweep, but it runs across ALL tenants because reminders.py has no company filter. Delivery is still correct per tenant, but the trigger is not tenant-scoped. Consider limiting manual triggers to superadmin or passing company_id.
Nudges every enabled user in the company, including superadmin. It ignores any audience targeting and does not exclude the poster (the poster is only skipped if they already read it).

integration_issues.flow: Layout polling for the HR role
integration_issues.issue: GET /api/payroll/cutoff/status returns 403 repeatedly for hradmin1 and spams the console with 'Failed to load resource 403'. Already there before this work, not part of the new features.

issues: The 'fixed inset-0' backdrop dims only the main content container. The sidebar and top header stay undimmed, probably because a transformed or animated ancestor creates a containing block. Render the modal through a portal to fix it.

critical_code_review_comments: The interview time is treated as UTC. That is correct for Sierra Leone (GMT), but document it in case the app is used in other timezones.
Rescheduling resets reminder_sent=False, so a rescheduled interview inside 24h gets a fresh reminder. This looks intended.
The Leavers CSV export button is not disabled when the month has no leavers. It downloads a file with only the header row. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_ vacancy and application, a TEST_ urgent announcement (with reads and 79 reminders) and a TEST_Leaver employee plus a completed offboarding. All of it was deleted by id afterwards (iter41_cleanup.py).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run: python /app/tests/iter41_setup.py (writes /tmp/iter41.json), then iter41_verify.py interview|announce|leavers, then iter41_cleanup.py. The server clock is Nov 2026. admin1 and hradmin1 share the Demo Salone tenant.
